name: exchange-api
description: Ballerina REST service that lists supported currencies and returns the current exchange rate of a given currency to USD, sourced daily from an external exchange-rate provider. Called only by exchange-webapp; publicly reachable with no sign-in required. Does not perform arbitrary amount conversion, history, or store per-user data.

dependencies.name: exchange-rate-provider
dependencies.description: Daily USD-based currency exchange rate data, used by the service to look up the requested currency's rate against USD. Not yet pinned to a specific provider — see candidates.

candidates.name: exchangerate-api
candidates.description: ExchangeRate-API (v6.exchangerate-api.com) — the previously-pinned choice; simple key-in-URL REST API, generous free tier, daily updates on the free plan.

candidates.name: frankfurter
candidates.description: Frankfurter (api.frankfurter.dev) — free and keyless, sourced from European Central Bank daily reference rates, open source; no API key config needed at all.

candidates.name: fixer
candidates.description: Fixer.io — well-established forex data API with historical and time-series endpoints beyond just latest rates, API-key authenticated.

candidates.name: currencyfreaks
candidates.description: CurrencyFreaks — permanently free plan (1,000 calls/month) covering 1,025 currencies, API-key authenticated, JSON/XML output.
